desc: Read input H, W, grid A, and queries Q.
If $H > W$, swap $H$ and $W$ and transpose the grid $A$ so that the smaller dimension is the number of rows.
Precompute prefix products for each column to facilitate the construction of the transition matrices.

Implement a Segment Tree where each node stores an $H \times H$ matrix. The leaf for column $j$ stores the matrix $M_j$ such that $V_j = M_j V_{j-1}$, where $V_j$ is the vector of DP values for column $j$.
Implement matrix multiplication for $H \times H$ matrices modulo 998244353.
Build the initial Segment Tree with the computed matrices.

Process each query: update the grid value $A_{h,w}$, recompute the affected transition matrix $M_w$, update the Segment Tree, and print the value at the bottom-right corner of the resulting DP table (which corresponds to the last element of the vector obtained by multiplying the root matrix with the initial vector).
